SELECT 
  c.platform,
  COUNT(*) as total_posts,
  AVG(CASE 
    WHEN s.sentiment = 'positive' THEN 1 
    WHEN s.sentiment = 'negative' THEN -1 
    ELSE 0 
  END) as sentiment_avg,
  SUM(CAST(json_extract(c.engagement_json, '$.likes') AS INTEGER) + 
      CAST(json_extract(c.engagement_json, '$.retweets') AS INTEGER) + 
      CAST(json_extract(c.engagement_json, '$.score') AS INTEGER)) as total_engagement
FROM content_raw c
LEFT JOIN content_signals s ON c.id = s.content_id
WHERE c.captured_at >= datetime('now', '-24 hours')
GROUP BY c.platform

SELECT 
  json_each.value as keyword,
  COUNT(*) as frequency
FROM content_signals,
  json_each(keywords_json)
WHERE enriched_at >= datetime('now', '-24 hours')
GROUP BY keyword
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  c.platform,
  c.text,
  c.author,
  c.url,
  s.sentiment,
  (CAST(json_extract(c.engagement_json, '$.likes') AS INTEGER) + 
   CAST(json_extract(c.engagement_json, '$.retweets') AS INTEGER) + 
   CAST(json_extract(c.engagement_json, '$.score') AS INTEGER)) as engagement_total
FROM content_raw c
LEFT JOIN content_signals s ON c.id = s.content_id
WHERE c.captured_at >= datetime('now', '-24 hours')
  AND s.sentiment = 'negative'
ORDER BY engagement_total DESC
LIMIT 5
